# Claude Cert Prep

> Free, unofficial practice portal for Anthropic's Claude certification program — unlike most other Claude cert prep (Udemy courses, paid question banks), every practice mode, mock exam, and diagnostic here is free with no paywall or premium tier; a free account is only needed to view your own results. All four tracks are fully live today: Claude Certified Architect — Foundations (CCA-F), with a 10,000+ question bank, a 30-lesson curriculum, mock exams, a diagnostic placement test, and spaced-repetition drill; Claude Certified Architect — Professional (CCAR-P), a 500-question bank across 7 domains for senior architects; Claude Certified Associate — Foundations (CCAO-F), a non-technical 500-question bank across 7 domains for business users of Claude; and Claude Certified Developer — Foundations (CCDV-F), a hands-on implementation-focused 500-question bank across 8 domains for developers building on the Claude API. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Anthropic.

## CCA-F study tools
- [Mock Exam](https://thatclaude.com/exam): 60 domain-weighted questions, 120-minute timer, scaled 100-1000 score, pass mark 720.
- [Diagnostic](https://thatclaude.com/diagnostic): 25-question untimed placement test with a per-domain study order.
- [Quick Practice](https://thatclaude.com/practice): configurable practice sets by domain and difficulty.
- [Drill](https://thatclaude.com/drill): spaced-repetition review of previously-answered questions.
- [Question Bank](https://thatclaude.com/browse): search all questions with answers and explanations.

## CCA-F curriculum and reference
- [Curriculum](https://thatclaude.com/learn): 30 lessons across the 5 CCA-F domains.
- [Glossary](https://thatclaude.com/glossary): exam-focused term definitions per domain.
- [Quick Reference](https://thatclaude.com/reference): condensed decision-rule cheat sheets per domain.
- [How to Pass](https://thatclaude.com/prep): study strategy, mental models, and an FAQ.
- [Blog](https://thatclaude.com/blog): study-strategy and domain deep-dive posts.

## CCAR-P study tools
- [Mock Exam](https://thatclaude.com/ccar-p/exam): 63 domain-weighted questions across 7 domains, 120-minute timer, scaled 100-1000 score, pass mark 720.
- [Quick Practice](https://thatclaude.com/ccar-p/practice): configurable practice sets by domain and difficulty.

## CCAO-F study tools
- [Mock Exam](https://thatclaude.com/ccao-f/exam): 60 domain-weighted questions across 7 domains, 120-minute timer, scaled 100-1000 score, pass mark 720.
- [Quick Practice](https://thatclaude.com/ccao-f/practice): configurable practice sets by domain and difficulty.

## CCDV-F study tools
- [Mock Exam](https://thatclaude.com/ccdv-f/exam): 53 domain-weighted questions across 8 domains, 120-minute timer, scaled 100-1000 score, pass mark 720.
- [Quick Practice](https://thatclaude.com/ccdv-f/practice): configurable practice sets by domain and difficulty.

## Program
- [Certifications](https://thatclaude.com/certifications): status of all four Anthropic certification tracks — CCA-F, CCAR-P, CCAO-F, and CCDV-F are all live.
- [About](https://thatclaude.com/about): who built this and why, and how the question bank is generated.

## Exam blueprint — CCA-F
- Agentic Architecture — 27%
- Tools & MCP — 18%
- Claude Code — 20%
- Prompt Engineering — 20%
- Context & Reliability — 15%

## Exam blueprint — CCAR-P
- Solution Design — 17%
- Prompting & Context — 13%
- Integration — 19%
- Eval & Optimisation — 16%
- Governance & Safety — 14%
- Stakeholder & Lifecycle — 14%
- Dev Productivity — 7%

## Exam blueprint — CCAO-F
- Prompting & Tasks — 14%
- Output Evaluation — 21%
- Product & Model — 12%
- Workflow Integration — 16%
- Configuration — 12%
- Governance & Risk — 15%
- Troubleshooting — 10%

## Exam blueprint — CCDV-F
- Apps & Integration — 33.1%

- Agents & Workflows — 14.7%
- Prompt & Context — 11%
- Tools & MCPs — 10.6%
- Security & Safety — 8.1%

- Claude Code — 3.1%
